sixDefectClosure.finding: The watchdog requires command[1] to be the wrapper and command[2:4] to be --script plus engine, but does not constrain command[0] to the Python interpreter. An arbitrary successful executable can receive those three strings as unused arguments and return zero without executing either authorized tool.
stable_tool now authorizes engine and wrapper by immutable path/SHA without post-receipt mtime.
Deterministic IDs, dossier/worksheet identity and term, nonempty senses/occurrences, and research receipt IDs/terms are checked.
spanText must occur inside context in addition to the existing exact hashes and matched term.
The exact configured outputRoot/ID/entry.v2.json path and config SHA are now bound.

clock permits timegate mtime up to one second after startedEpoch, while post_receipt still compares cohort artifacts only to startedEpoch. An artifact at started+0.1 can therefore predate a timegate written at started+0.9 and still pass. No check compares artifact mtime directly with actual timegate mtime.

remainingFiniteDelta: Require command[0] to resolve to the governed Python interpreter (or otherwise prove the wrapper was the actual executed program), and add a negative arbitrary-executable/decorative-argv test.
Return the actual timegate mtime from clock and require every candidate-specific artifact mtime to be at or after max(startedEpoch, timegate mtime); add a sub-second pre-timegate artifact test.
